day4_arrive.name: Me
day4_arrive.text: *I arrived at the meeting spot. I'm a bit early.*

day4_arrive_nervous.name: Me
day4_arrive_nervous.text: *My hands are sweaty in my pockets. Why am I so nervous... Let me take a deep breath.*

day4_arrive_people.name: Me
day4_arrive_people.text: *I look around. On the street, there are couples walking and laughing, a family eating ice cream, someone walking their dog...*

day4_arrive_phone.name: Me
day4_arrive_phone.text: *I take out my phone. No messages yet. I check the time — I arrived 15 minutes early.*

day4_arrive_look.name: Me
day4_arrive_look.text: *I sneak a glance at my reflection in a window. Not bad... I think.*

day4_arrive_wait.name: Me
day4_arrive_wait.text: *My heart is racing. Have I ever been this nervous before...*

day4_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_meet_seoyeon.text: "Oh, you're already here? I came early too... Hehe."

day4_seoyeon_react.name: Me
day4_seoyeon_react.text: *Seoyeon walks over with a smile. Meeting outside of school... she looks different from usual.*

day4_seoyeon_blush.name: Seoyeon
day4_seoyeon_blush.text: "W-what... You can't just say that out of nowhere... Thanks."

day4_seoyeon_happy.name: Seoyeon
day4_seoyeon_happy.text: "Really? I put a lot of effort in today! I'm glad you noticed!"

day4_yuna_angry_greeting.name: Yuna
day4_yuna_angry_greeting.text: "...You're here. But why did you lie to me yesterday?"

day4_yuna_react.name: Me
day4_yuna_react.text: *Yuna was standing in front of the café. She gives off a different vibe outside of school.*

day4_yuna_blush.name: Yuna
day4_yuna_blush.text: "...No one's ever said that to me before. ...Thanks."

day4_yuna_cool.name: Yuna
day4_yuna_cool.text: "...I just got here. Let's go in."

day4_dain_react.name: Me
day4_dain_react.text: *Dain waves and runs over. Meeting outside of school, the vibe is totally different.*

day4_dain_blush.name: Dain
day4_dain_blush.text: "H-hehe... Really?! I spent so long deciding what to wear!! What a relief!!"

day4_dain_energy.name: Dain
day4_dain_energy.text: "It was totally perfect!! I'm in top shape today!! Come on, let's go!!"

day4_meet_nurse.name: School Nurse
day4_meet_nurse.text: "Oh my, you're already here? Have you been waiting long?"

day4_nurse_react.name: Me
day4_nurse_react.text: *The school nurse is waving and smiling at the museum entrance. Meeting outside of school, the atmosphere feels completely different.*

day4_nurse_compliment.name: Me
choices: "It's kind of strange meeting outside of school."

day4_nurse_blush.name: School Nurse
day4_nurse_blush.text: "Hehe... Thank you. Can I see you as just a man today, not a student?"

day4_nurse_smile.name: School Nurse
day4_nurse_smile.text: "Right, I'm a bit nervous too. Today, I'm not a teacher — just me."

day4_meet_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_meet_teacher.text: "Oh, you made it. I thought you'd be late, but you're surprisingly early."

day4_teacher_react.name: Me
day4_teacher_react.text: *The homeroom teacher is smiling in front of the café. She looks so different outside of school that I almost didn't recognize her.*

day4_teacher_blush.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_teacher_blush.text: "...What, all of a sudden. Stop it, compliments make me feel weird."

day4_teacher_casual.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_teacher_casual.text: "Right? The coffee here is great. Come on, let's go in."

day4_date_walk.name: Me
day4_date_walk.text: *We walked side by side, chatting about all sorts of things. A relaxed atmosphere, different from school.*

day4_date_talk_1.name: Me
day4_date_talk_1.text: *Things we could never talk about at school... favorite music, childhood dreams, little hobbies.*

day4_date_talk_2.name: Me
day4_date_talk_2.text: *The more we talk, the closer I feel. I wish this moment could last forever.*

day4_date_weather.name: Me
day4_date_weather.text: *A gentle breeze blows. Cotton candy clouds drift slowly across the sky.*

day4_date_surroundings.name: Me
day4_date_surroundings.text: *I see other couples around, just like us. I suddenly wonder, 'Do we look like that too?'*

day4_date_time_pass.name: Me
day4_date_time_pass.text: *I have no idea how time flew by so fast. I check my phone and realize an hour has already passed.*

day4_date_sunshine.name: Me
day4_date_sunshine.text: *Sunlight pours through the leaves. The light falling on the face of the person walking beside me is... beautiful.*

day4_activity_seoyeon_1.name: Seoyeon
day4_activity_seoyeon_1.text: "Wow, look over there! A flower garden! Let's go!!"

day4_activity_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day4_activity_seoyeon_2.text: *Seoyeon grabs my hand and runs into the flower garden. She beams brightly among the colorful flowers.*

day4_activity_seoyeon_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_activity_seoyeon_3.text: "Oh, look, ducks! Should we give them some bread? I bought some at the convenience store!"

day4_activity_seoyeon_4.name: Me
day4_activity_seoyeon_4.text: *We sat side by side, tossing bread to the ducks in the pond. When the ducks waddled over, Seoyeon burst out laughing.*

day4_activity_yuna_1.name: Yuna
day4_activity_yuna_1.text: "...Can we stop by the bookstore? There's a book I want to read."

day4_activity_yuna_2.name: Me
day4_activity_yuna_2.text: *We flipped through books side by side in the bookstore. Yuna gets really serious when she's picking out a book.*

day4_activity_yuna_3.name: Yuna
day4_activity_yuna_3.text: "...Do you like this song? Want to listen with one earbud?"

day4_activity_yuna_4.name: Me
day4_activity_yuna_4.text: *Yuna handed me one of her earbuds. We sat close together, listening to the same music. Her shoulder gently touched mine.*

day4_activity_dain_1.name: Dain
day4_activity_dain_1.text: "Hey hey hey, there's an arcade over there!! Let's go let's go let's go!!"

day4_activity_dain_2.name: Me
day4_activity_dain_2.text: *Dain's eyes light up as she dashes into the arcade. She stops in front of a rhythm game and gives me a challenging look.*

day4_activity_dain_3.name: Dain
day4_activity_dain_3.text: "It's a showdown!! Loser buys ice cream!! I'm NOT losing!!"

day4_activity_dain_4.name: Me
day4_activity_dain_4.text: *I ended up losing. Dain pumps both fists in the air and cheers. I lost, but... seeing her that happy is a pretty good sight.*

day4_activity_nurse_1.name: School Nurse
day4_activity_nurse_1.text: "Don't you love this painting? The colors are so warm."

day4_activity_nurse_2.name: Me
day4_activity_nurse_2.text: *The museum was quiet and spacious. We walked slowly, viewing the paintings side by side. I like moments like this.*

day4_activity_nurse_3.name: School Nurse
day4_activity_nurse_3.text: "When I was a student, I had so many dreams too. I still do, but... they've just changed a little."

day4_activity_nurse_4.name: Me
day4_activity_nurse_4.text: *She stopped in front of one painting. Her profile, gazing at the landscape in the painting... was unexpectedly beautiful.*

day4_activity_teacher_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_activity_teacher_1.text: "What do you want to do after you graduate? Do you have a dream or anything?"

day4_activity_teacher_2.name: Me
day4_activity_teacher_2.text: *We sat across from each other in the café, talking. She has a softer expression than usual.*

day4_activity_teacher_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
day4_activity_teacher_3.text: "When I was a student, I never thought I'd become a teacher. Life doesn't go as planned. But now... it's not bad."

day4_activity_teacher_4.name: Me
day4_activity_teacher_4.text: (She cut a piece of her cake and placed it on my plate. "Try it, the desserts here are really good." My heart skipped a beat at that casual gesture.)

day4_activity_converge.name: Me
day4_activity_converge.text: *Time flew by so fast. Before I knew it, it was already lunchtime.*

day4_date_lunch.name: Me
day4_date_lunch.text: *We went into a cute café nearby. Sitting across from each other by the window — is it just me, or does this feel even more exciting?*

day4_lunch_menu.name: Me
day4_lunch_menu.text: *I look at the menu. Pasta, sandwiches, brunch set... What should I order?*

day4_lunch_order.name: Me
day4_lunch_order.text: "I'll go with the pasta. What would you like?"

day4_lunch_order_react.name: Me
day4_lunch_order_react.text: *They picked something too. After ordering, there's a brief awkward silence.*

day4_lunch_awkward.name: Me
day4_lunch_awkward.text: *I feel like I should say something... What would be natural to talk about at a time like this?*

day4_lunch_funny.name: Me
day4_lunch_funny.text: *The food arrived. The pasta I ordered is way bigger than I expected. They can't hold back their laughter at the sight.*

day4_lunch_funny_react.name: Me
day4_lunch_funny_react.text: "Why are you laughing! I can totally handle this much!"

day4_lunch_share.name: Me
day4_lunch_share.text: *We ended up sharing each other's food. Every time our forks bump on the same plate, we can't help but laugh.*

day4_date_lunch_talk.name: Me
day4_date_lunch_talk.text: *The conversation blossomed. Laughing together, thinking together... So this is what happiness feels like.*

day4_lunch_learn.name: Me
day4_lunch_learn.text: *The more we talk, the more I learn about sides of them I never knew. Favorite season, food they dislike, childhood nicknames... These little things feel so precious.*

day4_date_lunch_choice.name: Me
day4_date_lunch_choice.text: *Should I bring up something more personal?*
choices: "To be honest... I was pretty lonely before I transferred here."
"I've met really great people since coming to this school."

day4_date_honest.name: Me
day4_date_honest.text: "The new environment scared me... but thanks to you, now I look forward to every day."

day4_date_honest_react.name: Me
day4_date_honest_react.text: *They listened quietly to my story. Did my sincerity get through? They nod with warm eyes.*

day4_date_grateful.name: Me
day4_date_grateful.text: "Especially... right now, this moment is the best."

day4_date_grateful_react.name: Me
day4_date_grateful_react.text: *They look away slightly, smiling. They're definitely happy about what I said.*

day4_date_response.name: Me
day4_date_response.text: *Their eyes softened. Something just connected between us.*

day4_date_cafe_exit.name: Me
day4_date_cafe_exit.text: *As we step out of the café, warm afternoon sunlight pours down. Somehow, the distance between us has gotten smaller.*

day4_date_photo_moment.name: Me
day4_date_photo_moment.text: *I suddenly want to capture this moment.*
choices: *I'll keep this moment in my heart.*

day4_date_photo_yes.name: Me
day4_date_photo_yes.text: *We stood side by side and took a selfie. Two people smiling together on the screen. I want to keep this photo forever.*

day4_date_photo_no.name: Me
day4_date_photo_no.text: *More vivid than any photo, I engrave this moment into my memory. The scent of the breeze, the warmth of the sun, the smile of the person beside me.*

day4_date_ending_moment.name: Me
day4_date_ending_moment.text: *Walking side by side, a brief silence falls. It's not awkward — it's a comfortable silence. We've become the kind of people who are okay without saying a word.*

day4_date_ending_feel.name: Me
day4_date_ending_feel.text: *Today feels like a dream. I never imagined such a wonderful day would come after transferring here... truly.*

day4_date_transition.name: Me
day4_date_transition.text: *The afternoon still awaits. This date... isn't over yet.*
